publication_policy.catalog_url: Versioned immutable URL whose path contains catalog_release
publication_policy.asset_url: HTTPS content-addressed immutable object URL whose path contains SHA256

empty_catalog_policy.reason: No external asset is currently approved for public redistribution; users may import compatible offline modules they are authorized to use. BLOCKED assets remain unavailable.

notes: This first-release catalog is intentionally empty: no external asset is public until its redistribution rights are explicitly approved.
Large references, models, runtimes and containers remain separate from the Conda package.
HTTPS and SHA256 detect transport/content mismatch but are not a substitute for signed TUF metadata.
TUF, signed metadata, cryptographic freshness and production keys are deferred; no private keys are included or generated.
